title: Massive Issues Today
body:
Here’s a clean and complete bug report template based on your input:

---

## Environment

* **Platform**: <!-- Select one: Linux / macOS / Windows / WSL / Other -->
* **Claude CLI version**: <!-- output of `claude --version` -->
* **Operating System**: <!-- e.g., Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04 -->
* **Terminal**: <!-- e.g., iTerm2, Windows Terminal, etc. -->

## Bug Description

Repeated 503 errors and "Offline" issues throughout the day. MCP servers are not functioning as expected. This issue also occurred yesterday.
The following messages are being returned repeatedly during usage:

```
⎿  API Error (503 no healthy upstream) · Retrying in 5 seconds… (attempt 4/10)  
⎿  API Error (503 no healthy upstream) · Retrying in 8 seconds… (attempt 5/10)  
⎿  API Error (503 no healthy upstream) · Retrying in 18 seconds… (attempt 6/10)  
⎿  API Error (503 no healthy upstream) · Retrying in 36 seconds… (attempt 7/10)  
⎿  API Error (503 no healthy upstream) · Retrying in 33 seconds… (attempt 8/10)  
⎿  API Error (503 no healthy upstream) · Retrying in 40 seconds… (attempt 9/10)  
```

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Start Claude CLI from terminal
2. Trigger a task that uses MCP
3. Observe repeated upstream connection failures

## Expected Behavior

* MCP servers should connect and remain healthy
* Tasks should execute without interruption or retry delays

## Actual Behavior

* Server reports 503 errors ("no healthy upstream")
* Task execution is halted or delayed
* System reports as "Offline" despite being previously functional

## Additional Context

* Issue began intermittently but is now consistent
* No major config or CLI changes made between working state and failure state
* Same behavior observed across sessions and reboots
* Other network-dependent tools function normally

---

Let me know if you want to auto-fill any sections or submit this to a particular support channel.
